Many ppl seem to be confused about each cryptos role and don’t understand their niche.

Why is $XRP important? Let’s say I wanted to send $10M from NY (USA) Bank Of America to Steve’s bank in China. I would have to use the SWIFT system that would take days to weeks (sometimes months) to settle.

Why is this a problem?  It’s a problem because the bank in NY has to “hold” freeze $10M dollars and the bank in China has to also “hold” freeze $10M until the money is settled.

Remb, SWIFT doesn’t send money. It just allows the banks to communicate with one another. It’s like sending a text message from one bank to the other.

So now we have $20M frozen for a $10M transaction that Remb can take weeks or months to clear. But what if Steve in China wanted to take the $10M out and does. Now there’s $30M in limbo that can’t be touched for a $10M transaction.

This is where XRP comes in hand. There is currently $70 Trillion “locked up” around the world. Imagine if that money was freed. It can boost economies and move around the world as intended instead of being in no man’s land.

XRP Frees up all the money. If I used XRP to send that $10M from NY to China, the money would get there in seconds and settle in seconds. Both banks are “free” nothing is frozen. So in this scenario, XRP freed up millions of dollars by being quick and efficient and that’s what the financial system needs and will use.

The more money that’s moved, the higher the price of XRP. It can’t be cheap. To move $10M currently you would need roughly 4M XRP. If XRP was worth $1M then all you would need is 10 XRP to move the $10M.
